title: Strategic Value Engagement (v1)
description: Documents the engagement JSON exactly as index.html reads/writes it today (gatherEngagement at index.html:3935, applyEngagement at index.html:3854). Library lever definitions, formulas, evidence text, and ramp/tier tables live in CODE, not in this JSON. Saved engagements reference library levers by id via selectedIds and override input values via inputs. This is descriptive of v1; it is intentionally permissive (additionalProperties:true) because the loader ignores unknown keys and v2 will add fields additively.

_type.description: Type guard. importEngagementFile warns if present and different (index.html:3981).

_version.description: Written as 1; nothing reads it in v1 (no migration branch). A real consumer is added in the v2 migration shim.

_label.description: Human label, regenerated every save as '<customer> — saved <YYYY-MM-DD>' (index.html:3947). Display/console only; not loaded into any field.

_notice.description: Optional disclaimer banner text. Read by applyEngagement (index.html:3862); NEVER written by gatherEngagement. Authoring field for example/profile JSONs.

engagement.description: Intake/identity fields. All optional; all map 1:1 to text inputs.

verticals.description: Active industry keys (index.html:3949/3879). Values are vertical keys such as retail, warehouse, healthcare, manufacturing, government, carriers, aviation, hospitality, datacenter, energy, foodservice.

selectedIds.description: IDs of selected library levers (e.g. RET-01) and any active custom IDs as tracked in state.selectedIds (index.html:3937/3887).

inputs.description: Map of scenarioId -> { inputKey: number }. On save, only selected scenarios are emitted (index.html:3938); on load, values are merged onto library defaults (index.html:3890). Keys per scenario are defined by SCENARIOS[i].inputs and the matching calcSc case. Values are bare numbers (no per-value provenance).

customScenarios.description: User-defined levers (index.html:3952/3901). Enter calcNRV through the same ramp/tier/haircut/financeCredit gates as library levers, but carry no evidence citation or A/B/C confidence flag in v1.

active.description: Only active customs fold into the active set (index.html:5163)

mechanismId.description: One of CUSTOM_MECHANISMS ids (index.html:4868-4922); selects the closed-form formula.

inputs.description: Mechanism var values keyed by the mechanism's vars[].key.

rate.description: Credit applied to revenue/working_cap/soft ramp types; default 0.40

contingencyRate.description: Buffer on the Yr-0 cost subtotal; default 0.07 (index.html:3955/3916).

costRows.description: Explicit cost model. When present, the app stops merging slider defaults (index.html:3917-3921). Default rows assume an RFID hardware/tag/SaaS stack; no per-row technology label in v1.

qty.description: number, or "" on the contingency row

unitCost.description: number, or "" on the contingency row

contingency.description: Present/true only on the contingency row; its yr0 is recomputed from contingencyRate (index.html:4474)

nrvOverrides.description: Per-lever overrides for the SECONDARY NRV layer (nrvCfg), keyed by lever id, each { profile?, access?, h? } (index.html:2151-2161). READ by applyEngagement (index.html:3896) but NEVER written by gatherEngagement — a round-trip loss in v1. Hand-authored example JSONs may inject it and it will take effect on load.
